agents.claude-code.toml:
# =============================================================================
# Claude Code CLI
# =============================================================================
[agents.claude-code]
display_name = "Claude Code"
instruction_path = ".claude/CLAUDE.md"
project_instruction_path = ".claude/CLAUDE.md"
skills_path = ".claude/skills"

[agents.claude-code.detect]
commands = ["claude"]
paths = [".claude"]

[agents.claude-code.runner]
command = ["claude", "{prompt}"]

[agents.claude-code.subagents]
config_path = ".claude/agents"
config_format = "claude_markdown"

[agents.claude-code.mcp]
config_path = ".claude.json"
config_format = "claude_json"
name_style = "verbatim"
live_command = ["claude", "mcp", "list"]
auth_command = ["claude", "mcp", "login", "{target}"]
agents.codex.toml:
[agents.codex]
display_name = "Codex"
instruction_path = ".codex/AGENTS.md"
project_instruction_path = "AGENTS.md"
skills_path = ".agents/skills"

[agents.codex.detect]
commands = ["codex"]
paths = [".codex"]

[agents.codex.runner]
command = ["codex", "-C", "{workdir}", "{prompt}"]

# Local runner environment overrides are omitted from open-source exports.
# [agents.codex.runner.env]
# EXAMPLE_VARIABLE = "local-value"
[agents.codex.subagents]
config_path = ".codex/agents"
config_format = "codex_toml"

[agents.codex.mcp]
config_path = ".codex/config.toml"
config_format = "toml"
name_style = "underscore"                       # server-name -> server_name
builtin_mcps = ["openaiDeveloperDocs"]
live_command = ["codex", "mcp", "list"]
auth_command = ["codex", "mcp", "login", "{target}"]

# =============================================================================
# Claude Code CLI
# =============================================================================
agents.pi.toml:
[agents.pi]
display_name = "Pi"
instruction_path = ".pi/agent/AGENTS.md"
project_instruction_path = "AGENTS.md"
skills_path = ".agents/skills"

[agents.pi.detect]
commands = ["pi"]
paths = [".pi"]

[agents.pi.runner]
command = ["pi", "-p", "{prompt}"]

[agents.pi.subagents]
config_path = ".pi/agent/agents"
config_format = "pi_markdown"
requires_path = ".pi/agent/extensions/subagent/index.ts"

# =============================================================================
# Codex CLI
# =============================================================================
[agents.codex]
instruction_path = ".codex/AGENTS.md"
project_instruction_path = "AGENTS.md"
skills_path = ".agents/skills"

[agents.codex.detect]
commands = ["codex"]

[agents.codex.runner]
command = ["codex", "-C", "{workdir}", "{prompt}"]

# Local runner environment overrides are omitted from open-source exports.
# [agents.codex.runner.env]
# EXAMPLE_VARIABLE = "local-value"
[agents.codex.subagents]
config_path = ".codex/agents"
config_format = "codex_toml"

[agents.codex.mcp]
config_path = ".codex/config.toml"
config_format = "toml"
name_style = "underscore"                       # server-name -> server_name

live_command = ["codex", "mcp", "list"]
auth_command = ["codex", "mcp", "login", "{target}"]
